group: Pre‑walk listener returns true – walker is executed

cases.expected: validationMessages contains the ValidationMessage(s) returned by the JsonSchemaWalker (e.g., "msg-from-walker")
cases.description: The pre‑walk listeners return true, therefore the JsonSchemaWalker.walk method is invoked. Its returned ValidationMessage set must be added to the final result.

group: Pre‑walk listener returns false – walker is skipped

cases.expected: validationMessages is empty (no messages added by the walker)
cases.description: When the pre‑walk listeners return false, the JsonSchemaWalker.walk method must NOT be called. Consequently, the result set stays empty (apart from any post‑walk side‑effects).

cases.expected: post‑walk listener’s runPostWalkListeners method is invoked exactly once for each validator entry, regardless of the pre‑walk result
cases.description: The finally block must run after the if‑statement, so the post‑walk listener is called even when the pre‑walk listener returns false.

group: Exception thrown by walker – post‑walk still runs

cases.expected: post‑walk listener is invoked before the RuntimeException propagates; the test should verify the exception is thrown and post‑walk was called
cases.description: If JsonSchemaWalker.walk throws an exception, the finally block must still execute, invoking the post‑walk listener. The exception should bubble up after the finally block.

cases.expected: validationMessages contains the union of messages returned by all walkers whose pre‑walk listeners returned true; post‑walk listener called for each validator entry
cases.description: When the schema has more than one validator entry, the walk method must iterate over the entire map, applying pre‑walk, walker (if allowed), and post‑walk for each entry.

group: Empty validators map – returns empty set

cases.expected: returned Set is empty and no pre‑walk or post‑walk listener methods are invoked
cases.description: When the schema contains no validators (getValidators() returns an empty map) the walk method should finish immediately, returning an empty ValidationMessage set and never calling any listener.

group: Mixed pre‑walk outcomes – only true entries contribute messages

cases.expected: validationMessages contains only the messages from walkers whose pre‑walk listener returned true (e.g., "msg‑from‑walker‑A"), walkers with pre‑walk false contribute nothing; post‑walk listener called for each validator entry
cases.description: The schema has two validators: A (pre‑walk true) and B (pre‑walk false). The walk method must invoke the walker for A, skip B, and finally return the union of messages from A only.

group: Pre‑walk listener throws RuntimeException – post‑walk still executed

cases.expected: post‑walk listener’s runPostWalkListeners is invoked once for the validator entry, then the RuntimeException from the pre‑walk listener propagates
cases.description: If keywordWalkListenerRunner.runPreWalkListeners throws an exception, the finally block must still execute, calling the post‑walk listener before the exception bubbles up.

group: Post‑walk listener throws RuntimeException – exception propagates after call

cases.expected: RuntimeException from post‑walk listener propagates out of walk method; any ValidationMessage(s) returned by the walker (if pre‑walk was true) are still added to the result set before the exception
cases.description: When the post‑walk listener throws, the exception should not be swallowed; it must be re‑thrown after the finally block finishes. Messages collected before the exception must still be present in the returned set (if the method returns before the exception is thrown, the test can verify the exception is thrown).

group: Null executionContext – listeners receive null without NPE

cases.expected: walk proceeds; pre‑walk and post‑walk listeners are invoked with a null executionContext; no NullPointerException is thrown
cases.description: The method should not assume executionContext is non‑null; it must forward the null value to listeners and walkers, allowing them to handle it.

cases.expected: validationMessages contains the messages returned by the walker (e.g., "msg‑from‑walker"), proving that the flag does not prevent walker execution; post‑walk listener is still called
cases.description: The boolean flag is only passed to the walker; the walk method itself does not branch on it. This test confirms that setting it to false does not skip the walker.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when keywordWalkListenerRunner.runPreWalkListeners is invoked
cases.description: The JsonSchema instance has its keywordWalkListenerRunner field set to null. Calling walk should attempt to invoke runPreWalkListeners, resulting in a NullPointerException before any walker execution.

group: jsonWalker is null in validators map – NullPointerException

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when jsonWalker.walk is called
cases.description: The validators map returned by getValidators() contains a key with a null JsonSchemaWalker value. When pre‑walk listeners return true, the method tries to invoke walk on the null walker, causing a NullPointerException.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when attempting to iterate over a null validators map
cases.description: The JsonSchema instance is stubbed so that getValidators() returns null. The walk method calls getValidators().forEach, which throws a NullPointerException because the map reference is null.

group: jsonWalker returns null – NullPointerException on addAll

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when validationMessages.addAll receives a null collection
cases.description: The validator map contains a JsonSchemaWalker whose walk method returns null instead of a Set<ValidationMessage>. After a true pre‑walk result, walk attempts validationMessages.addAll(null), which throws a NullPointerException.
